uncertainty_score: weighted geometric mean of standardized model standard deviations; weights use the current three-point mean errors
accuracy_gate: maximum of the two objective-wise RMS relative errors over the three current Pareto representatives
fe_feasible_usage: diagnostic only; held-out gate representatives remain excluded from surrogate training
ablation_description: Remove only the (1 + I_d) importance gain from the A-DSE expansion; retain PF/EMA, annealing, reference span, gate and uncertainty AL.
comparison_reference: Same as the corresponding previous ablation; only NSGA-II population and generations change from 100x100 to 200x200. Historical Pareto fronts remain diagnostic logs only.
acquisition_rule: weighted geometric mean of two-objective model uncertainty
accuracy_gate_role: blocks A-DSE update until the three-point RMS gate passes
